title: Warlands The Age of Ice #3 Image Dreamwave 2001 Pat Lee Blade of the Empire
conditionDescription: Bright, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warlands: The Age of Ice #3 (October 2001), Image Comics / Dreamwave - Blade of the Empire. Pat Lee cover. $2.95 cover price.

Back cover: "Cries of Steel" September 11th, 2001 firefighter tribute by Pat Lee and the Dreamwave staff.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
